title: Accessibility
subtitle: Our commitment to making Sawdust & Scents usable by everyone.
commitmentBody: Sawdust & Scents is committed to ensuring our website is accessible to people with disabilities. We aim to conform to the <wcagLink>Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1</wcagLink> at Level AA. Accessibility is an ongoing effort, and we are continuously improving the user experience for everyone.
knownIntro: We are aware of the following limitations and are actively working to resolve them:
feedbackBody: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on our site, or if you need content in an alternative format, please <contactLink>contact us</contactLink>. We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days.
lastReviewed: This statement was last reviewed on
measures: Semantic HTML elements used throughout (nav, main, header, footer, h1–h6).
All interactive elements are keyboard-navigable and have visible focus indicators.
Colour contrast ratios meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text).
Form fields are labelled with associated label elements.
Modal dialogs trap focus correctly and can be dismissed with the Escape key.
The site is tested with keyboard-only navigation before each release.
knownIssues: Some product images uploaded by customers may not yet have alt text. We are working on a review process to address this.
The interactive product customiser is not fully accessible to screen reader users. A text-based alternative is on our roadmap.
